integrity.fixed_locus_basis: Generic diagonal conjugation fixes the diagonal projective space and the off-diagonal matrix-unit points.
integrity.localization_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.membership_basis: For s<d every matrix unit admits an invariant s-plane inside L; for s=d exactly the d(n-d) matrix units leaving L are excluded.
integrity.object_basis: The archival sources define the same higher Kalman varieties by existence of an invariant s-plane inside a fixed d-plane.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The arXiv record for 1105.5756 lists MSC 14M12 first, followed by 15A18, 13D02, and 13P25.

scientific_limitations: Only ordinary Euler characteristic and compactly supported Euler characteristic of adjacent layers are computed.
No claim is made about Betti numbers, Hodge structures, motives, intersection cohomology, or positive-characteristic analogues.
The fixed-point proof is short, so an unindexed or folklore observation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Euler rigidity across the higher Kalman filtration
